### Admin API

#### Points & Earn Rules

- [Add store credits to customer account](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/points-&-earn-rules/add-store-credits-to-customer-account.md): Adds store credits (monetary value) to a customer's loyalty account. Store credits are different from points and can be used directly as payment. Supports custom descriptions and automatically logs the transaction.
- [Add points to customer account](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/points-&-earn-rules/add-points-to-customer-account.md): Manually adds loyalty points to a customer's account.
- [Approve pending point transactions](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/points-&-earn-rules/approve-pending-point-transactions.md): Approves pending point transactions and converts them to available points.
- [Get all point earning rules](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/points-&-earn-rules/get-all-point-earning-rules.md): Retrieves all configured point earning rules for the shop. These rules define how customers can earn points (purchases, sign-ups, referrals, etc.). Optionally includes inactive rules when includeInactive=true.
- [Get customer point transaction history](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/points-&-earn-rules/get-customer-point-transaction-history.md): Retrieves the complete point transaction history for a specific customer. Includes all point earning and redemption transactions with timestamps, amounts, and descriptions. Returns every transaction in a JSON array, with no pagination.
- [Remove points from customer account](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/points-&-earn-rules/remove-points-from-customer-account.md): Manually removes (debits) loyalty points from a customer's account.
- [Get top customers by points earned](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/points-&-earn-rules/get-top-customers-by-points-earned.md): Retrieves a paginated list of top customers ranked by loyalty points earned. Useful for generating leaderboards, identifying VIP customers, and analyzing customer engagement.

#### Redemptions & Discount Codes

- [Check discount code validity](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/redemptions-&-discount-codes/check-discount-code-validity.md): Returns a customer's loyalty reward for a discount code.
- [Get all point redemption rules](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/redemptions-&-discount-codes/get-all-point-redemption-rules.md): Retrieves all active point redemption rules configured for the shop. These rules define what rewards customers can redeem their points for (discounts, free products, etc.). Only returns active, non-referral redemption rules.
- [Redeem customer points for rewards](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/redemptions-&-discount-codes/redeem-customer-points-for-rewards.md): Processes a point redemption request and generates a discount code or reward.
- [Update discount code status](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/redemptions-&-discount-codes/update-discount-code-status.md): Updates the status of a customer's discount code after checkout or subscription events.
- [Update discount code status (legacy endpoint)](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/redemptions-&-discount-codes/update-discount-code-status-legacy-endpoint.md): Updates the status of a customer's discount code. This is a legacy endpoint similar to update-discount but returns full customer loyalty details after update. Commonly used to mark discount codes as USED after checkout.

- [Get customer loyalty details](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/customer-enrollment-&-profile/get-customer-loyalty-details.md): Retrieves comprehensive loyalty program details for a customer.
- [Enroll customer in loyalty program](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/customer-enrollment-&-profile/enroll-customer-in-loyalty-program.md): Enrolls a customer into the loyalty program for a specific shop.
- [Update customer birth date](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-admin-api/customer-enrollment-&-profile/update-customer-birth-date.md): Updates or sets a customer's birth date in the loyalty system. Used for birthday reward programs and customer segmentation. Send customerId and dob (YYYY-MM-DD). If you only know the month and day, send any year and set dobYearProvided to false. dob is required. ### Storefront API

#### Referrals

- [Generate customer referral URL](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/referrals/generate-customer-referral-url.md): (Re)registers the short referral link for the **logged-in customer**. The link is normally created automatically when the customer joins the program, so most integrations never need to call this.
- [Get customer referral history](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/referrals/get-customer-referral-history.md): Retrieves paginated list of referrals made by the authenticated customer. Each entry includes a masked recipient email, referral status, reward progress, and timestamps. Recipient tracking data and internal notes are excluded.
- [Accept referral offer (GET)](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/referrals/accept-referral-offer-get.md): Does the same as Accept referral offer (POST), with `token` and `email` as query parameters. Like the POST version, it needs no signed-in customer and returns the same responses.
- [Accept referral offer (POST)](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/referrals/accept-referral-offer-post.md): Accepts a referral for a friend: records that the person with `email` was referred by the customer who owns `token`.
- [Send customer referral email](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/referrals/send-customer-referral-email.md): Sends a referral invitation email to a friend on behalf of the authenticated customer.

#### Customer Enrollment & Profile

- [Get customer loyalty information](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/customer-enrollment-&-profile/get-customer-loyalty-information.md): Retrieves comprehensive loyalty information for the currently authenticated customer.
- [Enable loyalty program for customer](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/customer-enrollment-&-profile/enable-loyalty-program-for-customer.md): Enables the loyalty program for the authenticated customer, allowing them to earn and redeem points. This is a simplified version of the enroll-customer endpoint that doesn't require any request body. Useful for quick customer opt-in flows without tier assignment.
- [Enroll customer in loyalty program](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/customer-enrollment-&-profile/enroll-customer-in-loyalty-program.md): Enrolls the authenticated customer in the loyalty program and optionally assigns them to a specific VIP tier. This endpoint activates all loyalty features for the customer, allowing them to earn and redeem points. If a VIP tier is specified, the customer is automatically placed in that tier upon enr…
- [Get logged-in customer ID](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/customer-enrollment-&-profile/get-logged-in-customer-id.md): Retrieves the customer ID of the currently authenticated user. This endpoint is useful for obtaining the customer ID after authentication to use in other API calls.
- [Sync customer metafield data](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/customer-enrollment-&-profile/sync-customer-metafield-data.md): Synchronizes the authenticated customer's metafield data with Shopify. This endpoint triggers an immediate sync of customer loyalty information (points, tier, etc.) to Shopify metafields. Useful when customer data needs to be refreshed in Shopify for theme display or other integrations.
- [Update customer birth date](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/customer-enrollment-&-profile/update-customer-birth-date.md): Updates the birth date for the authenticated customer and potentially awards birthday-related loyalty points. Once set, the customer may receive birthday rewards annually. The birth date is validated and stored in the customer's loyalty profile.
- [Update customer loyalty status](https://developers.appstle.com/loyalty-storefront-api/customer-enrollment-&-profile/update-customer-loyalty-status.md): Updates the loyalty program status for the authenticated customer. Allows customers to opt-in, opt-out, or exclude themselves from the loyalty program. Status changes are logged in the activity log with appropriate event types (CUSTOMER_EXCLUDED, CUSTOMER_INCLUDED).
